text:
```yaml
name: Prerelease CLI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Run tests
        run: npm test

      - name: Build project
        run: npm run build

  deploy:
    needs: build-and-test
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v2

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v2
        with:
          node-version: '14'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: npm install

      - name: Deploy to staging environment
        run: npm run deploy -- --environment staging

      - name: Verify deployment
        run: |
          echo "Check deployment logs at https://staging.example.com/logs"
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file `.github/workflows/prerelease-cli.yml` is designed to automate the build, test, and deployment process for the `AgentWorkforce/relay` repository. It includes two jobs:

1. **build-and-test**: This job checks out the code, sets up Node.js, installs dependencies, runs tests, and builds the project.
2. **deploy**: This job depends on the successful completion of the `build-and-test` job. It deploys the project to a staging environment and provides instructions to verify the deployment.

The workflow triggers on pushes and pull requests to the `main` branch.
